name: Escape Tsunami for Fruits
desc:
Welcome to Escape Tsunami For Fruits! 🌊

Run fast and collect Fruits! 🍎
Avoid massive tsunamis when they strike! 🌊
Stay alive and gather as many Fruits as you can! ⚡
Upgrade your Fruits to earn more money! 💸
Upgrade your base to unlock more slots and place extra Fruits! 🏗️

Your Fruits earn cash even when you're OFFLINE! 💤

Like the game and join the group for FREE MYTHICAL FRUIT! 👍
